notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content:
STALE? Checked 2026-08-04: isobar_pref_0_25 in moody_critical_mass_flux_homogeneous_eqm.rs:231 is NOT #[ignore]d — it carries a bare #[test] and is active. The only ignored test in that file is diagnose_deep_subcooled_failures (line 1351), which is a diagnostic that asserts nothing.

The crate CLAUDE.md previously claimed in one section that isobar_pref_0_25 was #[ignore]d while a later section said the Moody isobars were all active — an internal contradiction. That has now been corrected in CLAUDE.md, which points at this bead as a closure candidate.

Not closing it here — that is the maintainer's call. If the deep-subcooled deviation (|delta log10 G| = 0.170) is considered resolved by the region-filtering approach (assert only in-dome Region 4 points), this bead can be closed.

title: Moody isobar_pref_0_25 deep-subcooled point (#[ignore]d)
